paragraphs: Mentioned in [Ketubot 60a](https://www.sefaria.org/Ketubot.60a.1): he said the halakha follows R' Yitzchak, who stated it in the name of R' Yochanan; and Hyman suggests that perhaps it should read Rav Shimi bar Abba.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The linked Gemara reads Rav Shimi bar Abaye and distinguishes his endorsement of Rabbi Yitzchak’s ruling from Rabbi Yitzchak’s transmission in the name of Rabbi Yochanan. The linked line also contains a different transmission in the name of Rav.
ואולי צ״ל preserves Hyman’s tentative Abaye-to-Abba patronymic correction, not an established reading or identity merge. The chain and ruling direction remain unchanged.
